name: @szl-holdings/formulas
description: Canonical, thesis-sourced formula registry for the SZL platform. One typed pure function per formula, with provenance pointing back to its thesis section + version + first-seen commit. Re-exports the lutar-formulas corpus and adds: governance, risk, scoring, routing, and ROSIE-evolution helpers. Every export has an instrumented variant that emits a proof-ledger entry on every invocation.
